verdict.rationale: Lium ships an official pip-installable `lium` CLI, published in the Datura-ai/lium GitHub repo. Documented commands cover renting pods with a TTL (`lium up --gpu H100 --ttl 1h`), running remote commands that return the remote exit code for agent scripting (`lium exec`), price quotes (`lium quote`) and spend tracking (`lium spend`). The docs explicitly target agents running jobs without a browser. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agent workflows (the evidence is vendor docs and the vendor's own repo).
